notes: New Check-in tab: it reminds you about people you saved in your phone or who wrote to you on Telegram, WhatsApp, KakaoTalk or LinkedIn but are not in your network yet, chats worth a note, and saved details that may be out of date, with an optional evening reminder. The assistant now reads photos: attach a business card or a profile screenshot, take one with the camera, or share one into the app. The app's own voice input is removed; your keyboard's voice typing still works.
